newsitem.title: UK: British Airways adds to gains on slot hopes.
newsitem.headline: British Airways adds to gains on slot hopes.

text.p: British Airways shares added to Friday's advance in early trading amid continued buying interest on the prospect of European backing for the commercial trading of airport take-off and landing slots, traders said.
The shares were up another 20-1/2p to 615p early on Monday after a 34p gain on Friday.

Industry observers believe that the move could ease competition barriers, paving the way for acceptance of the UK airline's controversial plans of a transAtlantic alliance with AMR's American Airlines.
The inclusion of slot holdings could also add between 2.5 and five billion stg to British Airway's balance sheet, they said.
